{{Quote|This is Admiral Wieler on the ''Resilient'', calling General Plo&hellip;an enemy starship has entered the system.|Admiral Wieler, during the Battle of Khorm|<ref name="ISotR1" />}}
The '''''Resilient''''' was a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], it was a part of a task force led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]], and [[Tauht]] that was dispatched to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Khorm/Legends|Khorm]] to secure the valuable [[Agrocite/Legends|agrocite]] [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]]. However, by the [[Time/Legends|time]] the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] arrived at the planet, it had been occupied by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During the ensuing [[Battle of Khorm/Legends|battle]], the ''Resilient'' served as the personal [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of Republic [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wieler]]. Wieler could not utilize his [[Realspace/Legends|space]] forces at first because of a Separatist-created storm that raged in Khorm's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], but once the storm was extinguished, he used the ''Resilient'' and the rest of the [[Wieler's fleet|fleet]] to aid the Republic ground [[Troop/Legends|troops]].

==Description==
[[File:Resilient_nose.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The ''Resilient''{{'s}} nose view]]
The ''Resilient'' was a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] active by the early stages of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. On at least one occasion, it served as the personal [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of Republic [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wieler]]. Like all Republic ''Venator''-class [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]], the ''Resilient'' had a dual [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] tower, and portions of its hull were [[Color/Legends|red]] in color. Several [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]] and [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]] were stationed aboard the [[Starship/Legends|ship]].<ref name="ISotR2" />

==History==
{{Quote|All fighters&mdash;that vessel must not reach the surface!|Admiral Wieler, commanding from the ''Resilient''|<ref name="ISotR1" />}}
The ''Resilient'' was one of the many ''Venator''-class Star [[Destroyer/Legends|Destroyers]] manufactured by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]].<ref name="CCS" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Battle of Khorm date">{{TCWdates|201}} Furthermore, since ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: In Service of the Republic]]'' takes place prior to "Holocron Heist," ''In Service of the Republic'' can also be dated to 22 BBY.</ref> the ''Resilient'', along with two other Venators under Wieler's command, was dispatched to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Khorm/Legends|Khorm]] as part of a Republic task force led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]], and [[Tauht]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were tasked with securing Khorm's deposits of [[Agrocite/Legends|agrocite]], a valuable and rare [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] that could be used to exceptionally increase power to [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. Upon arrival at Khorm, Wieler positioned the ''Resilient'' and the rest of his forces in the planet's [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]]. By this [[Time/Legends|time]], however, the planet had fallen into [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] hands, so the Jedi needed to fight for the agrocite. After the initial Republic ground forces landed, a storm erupted in Khorm's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], preventing Wieler from sending reinforcements.<ref name="ISotR1" />

While the Jedi [[Battle of Khorm/Legends|fought]] the Separatists on the ground, a single starship&mdash;Separatist [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]' [[Trident (starship)/Legends|''Trident'']]&mdash;slipped past the ''Resilient'' and the other Venators and headed for the planet surface. Wieler dispatched a pair of V-19 Torrent starfighters to intercept the ship, but the ''Trident'' managed to reach the planet through an opening in the storm, while the V-19s were destroyed when the opening disappeared. Wieler analyzed the storm, discovering that the atmospheric distortion centered near the main Separatist agrocite [[Mining/Legends|mine]], which the Jedi sought to liberate. Contacting the Jedi from the ''Resilient''{{'s}} bridge, Wieler informed them of what had happened. The Jedi correctly guessed that the storm was created by a Separatist [[weather-control station]] and set off to destroy it.<ref name="ISotR1" /> Koon and Fisto managed to take the station down, and the storm dispersed, allowing Wieler to take the ''Resilient'' and the rest of his [[Wieler's fleet|fleet]] into Khorm's atmosphere and lend assistance to Republic [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Kendal Ozzel/Legends|Kendal Ozzel]], whose forces had been nearly decimated by Ventress.<ref name="ISotR2" /> The Battle of Khorm was eventually won by the Republic.<ref name="ISotR3">[[The Clone Wars 9|''The Clone Wars'' 9]]</ref>

==Commanders and crew==
{{Quote|Launch reinforcements.|Admiral Wieler, the ''Resilient''{{'s}} commander|<ref name="ISotR2" />}}
[[File:AdmiralWieler-TCW8.png|thumb|right|135px|Admiral Wieler]]
During the Battle of Khorm, the ''Resilient'' was commanded by Admiral Wieler, a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]. Wieler tried his best to help the Jedi in their fight, though he was initially unable to do so because of the storm. After the storm disappeared, Wieler's timely intervention saved the Republic [[Troop/Legends|troops]] on the surface from certain defeat.<ref name="ISotR2" /> The ''Resilient'' carried a number of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] aboard.<ref name="ISotR1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Resilient'' first appeared in [[The Clone Wars 7|seventh issue]] of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (comic series)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' comic series]]. The issue was written by [[Henry Gilroy]] and [[Steven Melching]], illustrated by [[Scott Hepburn]],<ref name="ISotR1" /> and released on [[July 15]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dark Horse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/16-238/Star-Wars-The-Clone-Wars-7|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars #7}}</ref>
